servinfo.title: Exhaust System Description
servinfo.ptxt: The exhaust system consists of an exhaust manifold incorporated in the cylinder head, a three-way catalytic converter (TWC), exhaust pipes, muffler, gaskets, and so on.
The TWC is an emission control device to lower the levels of Hydrocarbon (HC), Carbon Monoxide (CO) and Nitrogen Oxides (NOx) pollutants.
